content:
Let’s break this down:  

- The text says “He contains all works and desires and all perfumes and all tastes. He enfolds the whole universe…” → This suggests Brahman is omnipresent and pervades everything.  
- “This is the Spirit that is in my heart” → This indicates an immanent presence, but not only in the heart; the earlier part says he enfolds the whole universe.  
- “To him I shall come when I go beyond this life” → This suggests a transcendent aspect, but the key is that he is already present everywhere.  
- Option (A) matches “He enfolds the whole universe” and “contains all…”  
- Option (B) is not supported; paradise is not mentioned.  
- Option (C) is too narrow; he is in the heart but also everywhere.  
- Option (D) contradicts “in silence is loving to all.”  

So the best choice is (A).  

Final answer: (A)
